comment: Chains the Forsaken saga owns: Deathknell, Tirisfal Glades and Silverpine Forest. The saga key is the UnitRace token.

chains.name: Deathknell
chains.summary: Undertaker Mordo sends the way to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell, and the tasks lead through Novice Elreth, Deathguard Saltain, Aramis Hammerhand and Executor Arren to Executor Zygand in Brill.

quests.task: Speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis.
Kill 8 Mindless Zombies and 8 Wretched Zombies, then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell.
Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell.
Novice Elreth requires 6 Scavenger Paws and 6 Duskbat Wings.
Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.
Bring Samuel Fipps' Remains to Marla's Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.
Free 6 Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.
Kill 10 Young Night Web Spiders and 8 Night Web Spiders, then return to Executor Arren in Deathknell.
Bring Executor Arren 12 Scarlet Armbands from Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates.
Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, then bring the information to Executor Arren in Deathknell.
Deliver the Scarlet Crusade Documents to Executor Zygand in Brill.

chains.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
chains.summary: Executor Zygand in Brill asks for the death of Scarlet Crusade members in Tirisfal Glades, and Deathguard Burgess asks for 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings.

quests.task: Kill 10 Scarlet Warriors, then return to Executor Zygand in Brill.
Kill Captain Perrine, 3 Scarlet Zealots and 3 Scarlet Missionaries, then return to Executor Zygand in Brill.
Slay Captain Vachon and 5 Scarlet Friars, then return to Executor Zygand in Brill.
Assassinate Captain Melrache and his two bodyguards, then return to Executor Zygand in the town of Brill.
Bring 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings to Deathguard Burgess in Brill.
Punish 5 Deathguards for Executor Zygand.
Obtain reports from Deathguard Dillinger, Deathguard Kristof, and Gordo for Executor Zygand.

chains.name: The Mills of Tirisfal
chains.summary: Deathguard Dillinger in Brill asks for 7 Putrid Claws, then for 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls.

quests.task: Bring 7 Putrid Claws to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.
Gather 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls, then return to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.

chains.name: The Farthing Family
chains.summary: Coleman Farthing in Brill asks for remains of the Farthing family and of Devlin Agamand, then sends the way to Magistrate Sevren, who asks for the death of Captain Dargol.

quests.task: Bring Gregor's Remains, Nissa's Remains and Thurman's Remains to Coleman Farthing in Brill.
Slay Devlin Agamand, and bring Devlin's Remains to Coleman Farthing in Brill.
Speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
Kill 8 Wailing Ancestors and 8 Rotting Ancestors. Kill Captain Dargol, and bring his skull to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.

chains.name: The Prodigal Lich
chains.summary: Magistrate Sevren in Brill, Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity and Gunther Arcanus on the island of Gunther's Retreat give the tasks of the Prodigal Lich, ending with the Nether Gem brought to Bethor Iceshard.

quests.task: Kill Rot Hide Graverobbers and Rot Hide Mongrels. Bring 8 Embalming Ichors to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
Speak with Deathguard Linnea.
Return to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
Present Sevren's Orders to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
Bring the Lich's Spellbook to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
Return Gunther's Spellbook to him, on the island of Gunther's Retreat.
Obtain a Candle of Beckoning. Summon Lillith Nefara and kill her. Return to Gunther on his island.
Bring the Nether Gem to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

chains.name: Apothecary Johaan
chains.summary: Deathguard Simmer and Apothecary Johaan in Brill ask for pumpkins, Darkhound blood, Vile Fin Scales and Night Web Spider venom, and the last task takes Johaan's findings to Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest.

quests.task: Steal 10 pumpkins from the farm to the west, just north of Deathknell and take them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.
Take the Laced Pumpkin to the Captured Scarlet Zealot who is being held in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern.
Collect 5 Vials of Darkhound Blood for Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill.
Apothecary Johaan of the town of Brill needs 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in Tirisfal Glades.
Bring 4 samples of venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider to Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill.
Bring Johaan's Special Drink to the Captured Mountaineer.
Take Apothecary Johaan's findings to Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest.

chains.name: Doom Weed
chains.summary: Gordo asks for 3 Gloom Weed, and Junior Apothecary Holland in the Brill graveyard asks for 10 Doom Weed and 5 Tomb Weed.

quests.task: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the Brill graveyard.
Collect 10 Doom Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.
Collect 5 Tomb Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.

chains.name: Rear Guard Patrol
chains.summary: Deathguard Linnea asks for the death of Bleeding Horrors and Wandering Spirits and for Riptear's Heart, and Deathguard Kristof in Brill asks for the death of Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

quests.task: Kill 8 Bleeding Horrors and 8 Wandering Spirits, then report back to Linnea at her camp.
Bring Riptear's Heart to Deathguard Linnea.
Kill Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron for Deathguard Kristof in Brill.

chains.name: Bandarion Keep
chains.summary: Deathguard Terrence and Hadric Harlson send the way to Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades, where Leonid Barthalomew the Revered, Hilda the Breaker and Ephram Barbaro give further tasks.

quests.task: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the Undercity.
Kill 8 Dark Neophytes and 8 Dark Enforcers in Tirisfal Glades.
Gather 12 Necrotic Crystal Fragments in Tirisfal Glades.
Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
Observe the conversation between Danitha Morr and Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.
Deliver the Sealed Letter to Glix Xizzix in the Undercity.
Collect 6 Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.
Find the Hidden Crystal Fragment beneath Shadowvale for Ephram Barbaro.

chains.name: Requests in Brill
chains.summary: Gretchen Dedmar, Shelene Rhobart, Carolai Anise and Bareth Dawnstone ask for small tasks in and around Brill.

quests.task: Bring five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread to Gretchen Dedmar in Brill.
Bring Shelene Rhobart 8 Duskbat Wing Membranes, 6 Darkhound Hides and 3 Vile Fin Murloc Skin.
Collect 8 Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in Brill.
Help Bareth Dawnstone escape Crusader's Outpost, and report his safety to Shari Stilwell in Brill.

chains.name: Arugal's Folly
chains.summary: Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest asks for Moonrage Whitescalps, the Remedy of Arugal, shackles, the head of Grimson the Pale, Worgen Bits and the death of refugees.

quests.task: Kill 5 Moonrage Whitescalps, then return to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
Retrieve the Remedy of Arugal for Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
Bring 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
Kill Grimson the Pale and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
Bring 6 Pyrewood Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
Bring 6 Worgen Bits to Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.
Slay 5 Sickly Refugees and 5 Haggard Refugees for Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.

chains.name: A Recipe For Death
chains.summary: Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher and Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity ask for bear hearts, Skittering Blood, Apothecary Berard's journal, mosses and a Hardened Tumor.

quests.task: Collect 6 Grizzled Bear Hearts and 6 samples of Skittering Blood and deliver them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
Retrieve Apothecary Berard's journal from Pyrewood Village and take it to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
Bring 6 samples of Lake Creeper Moss, 6 samples of Lake Skulker Moss and a Hardened Tumor to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

chains.name: The Yoricks
chains.summary: High Executor Hadrec sends a search for the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick, and the chain covers worg hearts, murloc eyes, Quinn's potion, Ivar the Foul, Erland and the Deathstalker Report.

quests.task: Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick.
Gather 6 discolored worg hearts and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
Kill Ivar the Foul, and bring Ivar's Head to Rane Yorick at the Ivar Patch.
Escort Erland through the wolves, to Rane Yorick.
Bring the Deathstalker Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

chains.name: The Dead Fields
chains.summary: High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher sends tasks at the Dead Fields and the Decrepit Ferry, and the chain covers Deliah's Ring, Valdred Moray, rot hide ichor and Thule's Head.

quests.task: Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields. When Nightlash appears, kill her. Bring the Essence of Nightlash to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
Go to the Decrepit Ferry. Search for the reason the Scourge are there.
Bring Deliah's Ring to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
Bring Deliah's Ring to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
Bring Deliah's Ring to Raleigh.
Kill Valdred Moray. Bring his hands to Raleigh Andrean in the Undercity.
Bring 8 bottles of rot hide ichor to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
Bring the Sample Ichor to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.
Bring Bethor's Scroll to Apothecary Renferrel at the Silverpine Sepulcher.
Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
Bring Thule's Head to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.

chains.name: Ambermill Investigations
chains.summary: Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher asks for the contents of the Dalaran wizards' crates, Dalaran Pendants, the death of Dalaran Wizards, Watchers and the archmage, and Beren's Peril.

quests.task: Retrieve the contents of one of the Dalaran wizards' crates. Pyrewood Village lies to the south.
Bring the strange pendant to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
Take the rune-inscribed pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
Speak with Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
Obtain 8 Dalaran Pendants for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
Slay 8 Dalaran Wizards and 8 Dalaran Watchers for Shadow Priest Allister in the Sepulcher.
Kill the Dalaran archmage, then retrieve his staff for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
Locate Beren's Peril, then kill 6 Ravenclaw Drudgers and 6 Ravenclaw Guardians, then return to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

chains.name: Supplying the Sepulcher
chains.summary: Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher gives Podrig's Order to Karos Razok, and Gordon's Crate comes from Gordon Wendham in the Undercity via Michael Garrett back to Podrig.

quests.task: Bring Podrig's Order to Karos Razok.
Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig's Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.
Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.
Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.

chains.name: Requests in Silverpine
chains.summary: Deathstalker Faerleia asks for help against the Pyrewood Council, and Tabitha Heartweaver asks for an investigation of the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

quests.task: Help Deathstalker Faerleia kill the Pyrewood Council.
Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

chains.name: Samples for the Barrens
chains.summary: Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher gives the Wolf Heart Samples for Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity, and Apothecary Zinge gives the sample for Apothecary Helbrim in the Barrens.

quests.task: Speak with Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
Bring the Wolf Heart Samples to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
Bring the Wolf Heart Sample to Apothecary Helbrim in the Barrens.
